response.sql: WITH rm_orders AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as type_count FROM riskandmargin rm INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(type_count) as avg_count FROM rm_orders), above_avg_types AS (SELECT rmo.type_count, (rmo.type_count - oa.avg_count) as excess FROM rm_orders rmo CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE rmo.type_count > oa.avg_count) SELECT AVG(type_count) as average_of_counts, AVG(excess) as average_excess FROM above_avg_types
